video.title: Top 5 Best Business Checking Accounts To Open Right Now

summary: Casper Capital reviews five US business checking accounts: Relay, Novo, BlueVine, Chase and Capital One. It compares fees, APY, sub-accounts, cash deposits, wires and partner perks. The video argues that big-bank fees can approach $3,000 a year and recommends fintech accounts with profit-first buckets. It contains no business idea, only US banking advice, and the video uses affiliate links.

tactics.name: Profit-first bucket split
steps: Open multiple sub-accounts (taxes, payroll, profit, opex)
On each payment, auto-split e.g. 30% taxes, 20% profit, 40% opex, 10% payroll
Run the business on what's left

quote.text: you could send 30% to taxes, 20% to profit, 40% to operating expenses, and 10% to payroll
quote.speaker: Casper Capital narrator

tactics.name: Open a business bank account
steps: Get an EIN from the IRS (free)
Bring formation papers, business address and operating agreement if partners
Keep personal and business money separate

lessons.lesson: Separate business and personal finances for taxes, profit tracking and LLC liability protection.

quote.text: You should keep your personal and business money separate because this makes taxes way easier

lessons.lesson: Pick a bank by your cash, wire and balance profile; fees add up fast for cash-heavy or wire-heavy businesses.
Idle balances can earn 1-3.5% APY in fintech accounts instead of nothing.
Fintech partner perks (processing credits, free software) can offset first-year costs.
